summary: native-frontend-orb ships preinstall dropper that runs obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs', which fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun) to a tmp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line bundle using a shuffled string-array + numeric-dictionary decoder with hex identifiers (`_0x...`, `MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`) and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, deliberately executed only under Bun so Node-based inspection does not observe the payload's behavior. The package is advertised as a CircleCI orb (metadata references git@github.com:ornikar/orb-frontend-native.git) and its declared `main: index.js` is not present in the tarball — the package has no library surface and the only effect of installing it is running the obfuscated payload. Publish name is unscoped (`native-frontend-orb`) while the referenced repository is under the @ornikar organization, consistent with a dependency-confusion / impersonation shape targeting an internal Ornikar orb.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
